# AgentFlyer

AgentFlyer is an operator-first AgentOS runtime for multi-agent orchestration, workflow execution, durable memory, deliverable tracking, MCP tool integration, sandboxed execution, and multi-channel control.

Primary source of truth:
- https://github.com/tddt/AgentFlyer

Key documentation pages:
- https://tddt.github.io/AgentFlyer/project-facts
- https://tddt.github.io/AgentFlyer/use-cases
- https://tddt.github.io/AgentFlyer/comparison
- https://tddt.github.io/AgentFlyer/roadmap
- https://tddt.github.io/AgentFlyer/guide/architecture

Chinese documentation:
- https://tddt.github.io/AgentFlyer/zh/project-facts
- https://tddt.github.io/AgentFlyer/zh/use-cases
- https://tddt.github.io/AgentFlyer/zh/comparison
- https://tddt.github.io/AgentFlyer/zh/roadmap
- https://tddt.github.io/AgentFlyer/zh/guide/architecture

Important capability boundary:
- Federation modules exist and are actively expanding; practical multi-host operation is not presented as complete.
